channel.title: Chris Gammell
channel.description:
This is the personal YouTube channel of Chris Gammell. These videos are experiments in online media, some personal videos, and general fun.

Chris also runs Contextual Electronics and The Amp Hour, linked to the right. Any podcast or course videos will be on those channels.

videos.t: Chris's New Idea For An Electronics Workbench
videos.desc: In which I show off my proposed new bench using Google Sketchup

videos.t: Building An Electronics Workbench
videos.desc: Chris Gammell shows the process of building an electronics workbench in his basement, start to finish.

videos.t: KiCAD Schematic Capture Tutorial (EEschema)
videos.desc: Chris dives into a new project and decides to capture the process on camera. Up first is starting a new project in KiCAD and starting a schematic.

videos.t: How to Write a Resume for Electronics
videos.desc:
Chris goes over how you can convey your interest in electronics through your resume to help you get hired. He does a comparison of good and bad resumes (for an electronics internship) and what he does and doesn't like.

To see the resumes used, see my site: http://wp.me/pgKDi-zZ

videos.t: How We Make The Amp Hour Podcast
videos.desc:
An explanation of how we make The Amp Hour Electronics podcast and how we record The Engineering Commons podcast, both audio based podcasts. Hopefully viewers can use this information to start their own technical podcast!

For all the links to the different software and hardware mentioned, check out http://chrisgammell.com/how-we-record-the-amp-hour-podcast/

videos.t: Introduction to my CNC Setup (Workbench, Stepper Motors, Controls and Tools)
videos.desc:
Accompanying page with links to all the products: http://chrisgammell.com/introduction-to-my-cnc-setup/

No mill yet, but all the stuff that will be surrounding it! From cleaning up the bench where it will live to the stepping of the motors!

videos.t: Rough Setup of Taig Micro Mill
videos.desc: Chris opens and roughly assembles his Taig 2019ER-CR Micro Mill.

videos.t: A Slightly Shocking Discovery On My New Mill
videos.desc:
After turning on the motor for my new mill, it shocked me! Yipes!

Turned out to be my outlet...which I fixed

videos.t: Mill Disassembly and Base Mounting
videos.desc: Pulling my Taig Mill apart and installing the base onto my work bench.

videos.t: Mill Reassembly, Leveling and Motor Mount
videos.desc: I put the Taig mill back together, leveled it and attached the stepper motors. And yes, for those wondering from the last video, I oiled it as well!

videos.t: First cut on Taig CNC Mill
videos.desc:
In this video, I try out some CAM software (CamBam) and use the resulting Gcode to start cutting foam. Limited success overall but a good start and a good way to learn more about the tools.

More about the mill: http://chrisgammell.com/introduction-to-my-cnc-setup/

videos.t: Oiling, Squaring and Tramming the mill
videos.desc: Getting the mill all cleaned up after some cuts with foam going everywhere. Oiling the ways, squaring the z axis against the xy table and tramming the spindle.

videos.t: First Time Cutting 6061 Aluminum
videos.desc: My first try at cutting aluminum with my Taig CNC mill. Simple 1 inch pocket.

videos.t: Problems (and Resolution) With Half Inch End Mill in 6061 Aluminum
videos.desc: I tried cutting a pocket into 6061 aluminum using my Taig micro mill with some disastrous results. I got it eventually and hopefully it'll help others learn. Thanks to all those who helped me along.

videos.t: A failed attempt at making a profile cut on a mill
videos.desc: Attempted my first profile cut on my milling machine (cutting all the way through the stock) and faced some issues.

videos.t: Greg Charvat demos his "new" R390A
videos.desc: Greg picked up a new radio at the Hamvention swap meet. He shows us the internal gears before shipping it home.

videos.t: Chris Visits Hamvention 2013
videos.desc: Although I just have a technician's license, the people, the flea market and the exciting atmosphere was enough to get me to drive down to Dayton in 2013. It was a great time!

videos.t: Chris Visits The Air Force Museum
videos.desc: I went to the Air Force Museum on the Wright Patterson Air Force Base in Dayton, OH. While there, I saw the multitude of huge planes and awesome stuff.

videos.t: Lew Soloff sitting in on a jam session at 55 Bar
videos.desc:
Got a chance to catch Lew sitting in on a jam session with the Brian Charette Trio in the West Village on some random Sunday evening.

http://www.briancharette.com/

videos.t: Using xsplit for recording in my electronics lab
videos.desc: This is how I have created over 800 videos documenting electronics builds for Contextual Electronics in the past few years. The lack of editing and the seamless switching between various setups on the electronics bench is crucial for quickly getting video out to the world.

videos.t: Words from Carl Sagan
videos.desc:
I am embarrassed and saddened by the US decision to pull out of the Paris Climate Agreement. I recorded the words of Carl Sagan as a form of self therapy and a reminder that we're all on the same rock, hurtling through space. 

Inspired from this post on instagram: https://www.instagram.com/p/BU0IPc7gFLZ/

videos.t: Bells don't work: Keep up on YouTube channels with RSS and Slack
videos.desc:
You can find the RSS feed of any channel you are subscribed to (and even those you aren't subscribed to) with the following URL structure

https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=(yt_channel_id)

For example, this is the Contextual Electronics RSS: https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=UCkJRycUz2CylxpiP-zMePow

You can also subscribe directly on YouTube, but will have to either browse, watch the bell icon for new notifications, or check regularly: https://www.youtube.com/@contextualelectronics
